section.div: Favorites genres: Psychological, Drama, Thriller, Mystery, Fantasy, Romance

div.div: Koudo Ikusei Senior High School is a leading prestigious school with state-of-the-art facilities where nearly 100% of students go on to university or find employment. However, only the most superior students in Class A receive favorable treatment, while Kiyotaka Ayanokouji quietly pulls the strings from Class D.

Suddenly summoned to another world on his way home from the convenience store, Subaru Natsuki discovers he possesses the power of Return by Death—rewinding time whenever he dies as he fights desperately to save Emilia and those precious to him.

Dr. Kenzo Tenma, an elite neurosurgeon, risks his career to save the life of a young boy named Johan Liebert over a politician. Nine years later, Tenma discovers that the boy he saved has grown into a charismatic and ruthless monster.
Comedy, Drama, Romance, Slice of Life

Hachiman Hikigaya is a cynical high school student with a pragmatic view on youth and society. Forced by his teacher to join the Service Club alongside the ice queen Yukino Yukinoshita and cheerful Yui Yuigahama, he solves students problems in his own unorthodox way.
